reason: Verified in source and in the browser. brief.md line 51 defines state=day as "the day itself, the wedding morning", and render-b.js states.day (line 324) renders one body line: "Everything on the plan has happened. Nothing is left to count." Driving master.html?state=day at 390x844 in all three rooms (approach, paper, record) returns the same full text: TODAY | Mara & Finn | Saturday 3 October 2026 | Everything on the plan has happened. Nothing is left to count. | KEPT BY ORLA | UPDATED 15 JULY 2026 | SIGNAL TIMELINE. Two hard facts back the finding rather than taste. First, the tense is wrong against the fixture the screen itself is built from: "Wedding day" 2026-10-03 is a milestone in MILESTONES, so on the morning of 3 October the plan has not all happened, and the screen says it has. Second, the locating line is genuinely missing only here: horizon() at render-b.js line 45 puts "Wedding day at The Orchard" on owner-flight, owner-editing, phone, desk and print, and the day screen is the one place it is dropped, on the frame most likely to be screenshotted. "Nothing is left to count" is also backlog grammar in a product whose north star bans jargon, and the same defect was independently reached by the taste and UX seats. The fix is copy only, no new colour, weight, family or structure, and no automated gate asserts the string, so nothing regresses. Confirmed, with the fix sharpened: the proposed replacement line repeats the eyebrow and the proposed placement invents an order this screen does not use elsewhere.
sharpenedFix: Keep the finding, tighten the words and the placement. In render-b.js states.day, hold the horizon's own order rather than stacking two lines under the rule: after h("p.b-dayDate") insert h("p.b-sub", { text: F.project.primaryDate.label + " at The Orchard" }) so the day screen names where to be in exactly the construction every other state already uses, then the indigo rule, then the note. In b.css change .b-dayDate margin to 0 0 10px and add .b-dayWrap .b-sub { margin: 0 0 40px; } so the 40px gap before the rule is preserved; both lines are already 15px at fore-62, so no size, weight or colour is added. For .b-dayNote do not use "Today is the day." The eyebrow above it already reads TODAY, so the line repeats itself and lands as a stock phrase next to the ended and loading copy this seat rightly praises. Use one present-tense sentence that neither counts nor congratulates, in that same register: "This is the day the plan was for." Delete "Nothing is left to count" from render-b.js only. render-c.js line 269 carries the same sentence but build.mjs line 26 records c.css and render-c.js as the kept record of the exploration, not a shipped room, so leave it alone. Separately worth noting for a different finding, not this one: the day screen also drops the count that lock.md makes the first thing on the surface, and the whole set carries no clock time or address, so "where to be" here can only be as specific as the fixture allows.
